description: OpenVEX is an implementation of the Vulnerability Exploitability Exchange (VEX for short) that is designed to be minimal, compliant, interoperable, and embeddable.

@context.description: The URL linking to the OpenVEX context definition.

@id.description: The IRI identifying the VEX document.

author.description: Author is the identifier for the author of the VEX statement.

last_updated.description: Date of last modification to the document.

role.description: Role describes the role of the document author.

statements.description: A statement is an assertion made by the document's author about the impact a vulnerability has on one or more software 'products'.

@id.description: Optional IRI identifying the statement to make it externally referenceable.

action_statement.description: For a statement with affected status, a VEX statement MUST include a statement that SHOULD describe actions to remediate or mitigate the vulnerability.

action_statement_timestamp.description: The timestamp when the action statement was issued.

impact_statement.description: For statements conveying a not_affected status, a VEX statement MUST include either a status justification or an impact_statement informing why the product is not affected by the vulnerability.

justification.description: For statements conveying a not_affected status, a VEX statement MUST include either a status justification or an impact_statement informing why the product is not affected by the vulnerability.

last_updated.description: Timestamp when the statement was last updated.

products.description: List of product structs that the statement applies to.

status.description: A VEX statement MUST provide the status of the vulnerabilities with respect to the products and components listed in the statement.

status_notes.description: A statement MAY convey information about how status was determined and MAY reference other VEX information.

supplier.description: Supplier of the product or subcomponent.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is the time at which the information expressed in the statement was known to be true.

version.description: Optional integer representing the statement's version number.

timestamp.description: Timestamp defines the time at which the document was issued.

tooling.description: Tooling expresses how the VEX document and contained VEX statements were generated.
